item.title: Daily Brief — Friday, September 4, 2026
item.description:

  • Guardians took the opener 7-6 and nightcap 4-3, sweeping the Tigers in a pair of dramatic walk-off wins. (TIGERS)
  • Jared Jones [6 IP, 0 ER, 9 K | 4.49 ERA, PAR 16] led the Pirates past the Angels 1-0 at PNC Park, with Pittsburgh picking up half a game in the NL wild card race. (PIT)
  • Ranger Suarez [7 IP, 0 ER, 3 K | 3.46 ERA, PAR 39] tossed seven shutout innings as the Red Sox blanked the Orioles 1-0 in Baltimore. (BOS)
  • The Cardinals rallied from a 6% win probability to beat the Rockies 7-6 at Coors Field, the day's biggest comeback and largest WPA swing (4.11). (CARDINALS)
  • Blake Snell [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 1.97 ERA, PAR 15] threw six scoreless in the Dodgers' 5-3 win over Washington; Shota Imanaga [6 IP, 1 ER, 4 K | 3.92 ERA, PAR 29] led the Cubs past Miami 6-1. (LAD) (CHC)
  • The Padres edged the Yankees 3-2, while the Brewers extended their NL Central lead with a 10-7 win in Cincinnati. (BREWERS) (YANKEES)
  • The Athletics topped Seattle 7-6, dropping the Mariners another game back in the AL West; the Braves beat Philadelphia 5-2 to push their NL East lead to five. (BRAVES) (ATHLETICS)
  • Rafael Devers [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 92] and Brayan Rocchio [2-4, 2 HR | RC 54] led the day's hitters, with Rocchio homering twice in Cleveland's sweep. (SF) (CLE)
